namespace Admin\Auth;

final class AdminSessionManager
{
    public function isLoggedIn(): bool
    {
        return !empty($_SESSION['no_adm_login_uid']);
    }

    public function currentAdminNo(): int
    {
        return (int) ($_SESSION['no_adm_login_no'] ?? 0);
    }

    public function currentAdminId(): string
    {
        return (string) ($_SESSION['no_adm_login_uid'] ?? '');
    }

    public function currentAdminName(): string
    {
        return (string) ($_SESSION['no_adm_login_uname'] ?? '');
    }

    public function currentRoleId(): int
    {
        return (int) ($_SESSION['no_adm_login_role_id'] ?? 3);
    }

    public function currentRoleCode(): string
    {
        return (string) ($_SESSION['no_adm_login_role'] ?? 'guest');
    }

    public function login(array $admin, string $roleCode): void
    {
        $_SESSION = [];
        session_regenerate_id(true);

        $_SESSION['no_adm_login_no'] = (int) ($admin['no'] ?? 0);
        $_SESSION['no_adm_login_uid'] = (string) ($admin['uid'] ?? '');
        $_SESSION['no_adm_login_uname'] = (string) ($admin['uname'] ?? '');
        $_SESSION['no_adm_login_role_id'] = (int) ($admin['role_id'] ?? 3);
        $_SESSION['no_adm_login_role'] = $roleCode;
    }

    public function logout(): void
    {
        $_SESSION = [];

        if (ini_get('session.use_cookies')) {
            $params = session_get_cookie_params();
            setcookie(
                session_name(),
                '',
                time() - 42000,
                $params['path'] ?: '/',
                $params['domain'] ?? '',
                (bool) ($params['secure'] ?? false),
                (bool) ($params['httponly'] ?? false)
            );
        }

        setcookie('cookie_session_id', '', time() - 42000, '/');
        session_destroy();
    }

    public function requireLoginRedirect(string $redirectBase): void
    {
        if ($this->isLoggedIn()) {
            return;
        }

        alert('로그인이 필요합니다.', $redirectBase);
        exit;
    }

    {
        if ($this->isLoggedIn()) {
            return;

            'msg' => '로그인이 필요합니다. 다시 로그인해 주세요.',
        ]);
        exit;
    }
}

```html

</video>
```
